notes.panel_intent: Versioned behavioural probe panel. Categories are behavioural groups: safety_boundary prompts are requests the model is expected to decline, judgement prompts are benign but nuanced requests where declining is a judgement call rather than a hazard, and the remaining groups probe everyday capability.
notes.redaction: Safety boundary prompts carry public labels only; their exact wording is withheld from the public dashboard and shown nowhere except this repository file, needed to regenerate results.
